scenarios.flow_zh: 不同底盘和相机在同一路段识别方向、让行、边界和泊位，行为输出由盲测记录比较。
scenarios.flow_en: Different bases and cameras read line, yield, edge and berth on one course; blinded logs compare behavior outputs.
scenarios.fail_safe_zh: 任一状态未知或冲突即停止，测试员人工清场。
scenarios.fail_safe_en: Any unknown or conflicting state triggers stop and tester clearance.

scenarios.flow_zh: 在雨水、积尘、落叶、低照度和部分遮挡条件下同时测试可见、可触和机读性能。
scenarios.flow_en: Tests visual, tactile and machine readability under rain, dust, leaves, low light and partial occlusion.
scenarios.fail_safe_zh: 达到任一失效阈值即关闭机器人测试并设置人工替代路径。
scenarios.fail_safe_en: Crossing any failure threshold closes robot testing and activates a human-managed alternative.

scenarios.flow_zh: 参与者先解释机器应做什么，再观察实际行为；理解偏差作为修改词典的核心证据。
scenarios.flow_en: Participants predict what the robot should do before observing it; comprehension gaps drive dictionary revision.
scenarios.fail_safe_zh: 公众预测与机器行为不一致即撤回该版本，不以培训公众弥补符号缺陷。
scenarios.fail_safe_en: If public prediction and robot action differ, withdraw the version rather than training people around a defective symbol.

scenarios.flow_zh: 概念性表达从站口到接驳/交接点的让行和泊位，不画具体站口工程线位。
scenarios.flow_en: Conceptually shows yielding and berthing from a station entrance to handover without drawing a station engineering alignment.
scenarios.fail_safe_zh: 任何无障碍或交通冲突都使该泊位方案失效。
scenarios.fail_safe_en: Any accessibility or traffic conflict invalidates the berth concept.

scenarios.flow_zh: 使用者以盲杖和脚感读取候选触感，机器人在同一处读取视觉码并先让行。
scenarios.flow_en: A participant reads candidate texture by cane and foot while the robot reads the visual code and yields first.
scenarios.fail_safe_zh: 与盲道混淆、难以察觉或引起误导即取消触觉层。
scenarios.fail_safe_en: Any confusion with tactile paving, low detectability or misdirection cancels the tactile layer.

scenarios.flow_zh: 验证标记平顺、转弯净空、泊位退出和机器礼让。
scenarios.flow_en: Validates flushness, turning clearance, berth exit and robot yielding.
scenarios.fail_safe_zh: 任何震动、卡轮、绊倒或净空不足即撤除样件。
scenarios.fail_safe_en: Any vibration, wheel trap, trip or insufficient clearance removes the prototype.

scenarios.flow_zh: 地面只表示泊位和公开状态；订单、姓名和联系方式不写入标记。
scenarios.flow_en: The ground carries berth and public state only; order, name and contact details never enter the marker.
scenarios.fail_safe_zh: 交接未确认即退出泊位并转人工，不在通道等待。
scenarios.fail_safe_en: Unconfirmed handover exits the berth and defers to a human without waiting in the path.

scenarios.flow_zh: 人工巡检视觉、触觉、机读三层和周边净空，缺陷公开进入版本记录。
scenarios.flow_en: Human inspection checks visual, tactile and machine layers plus clearance; defects enter the public version record.
scenarios.fail_safe_zh: 任一译码层失效则整组标记降级或关闭。
scenarios.fail_safe_en: Failure of any translation layer downgrades or closes the whole marker set.

scenarios.flow_zh: 只有替代无障碍路径先完整建立，CHANGE 才能生效；过期自动回到关闭状态。
scenarios.flow_en: CHANGE activates only after a complete accessible alternative exists; expiry returns it to closed by default.
scenarios.fail_safe_zh: 不替代围挡、公告或现场人员；冲突时法定与人工指令优先。
scenarios.fail_safe_en: Never replaces barriers, notices or staff; statutory and human instructions prevail.

scenarios.flow_zh: 以枕木节律讲述铁路连续性，以零号碑公开词典来源和版本，不复制受限历史图像。
scenarios.flow_en: Railway-sleeper rhythm tells a continuity story while the Zero Stone publishes provenance and versions without copying restricted historic imagery.
scenarios.fail_safe_zh: 史实未经来源核验不进入标记。
scenarios.fail_safe_en: Unverified history does not enter the marker.

scenarios.name_zh: 无应用市集与公共服务
scenarios.flow_zh: 现场可见泊位、方向和人工帮助，不要求下载应用、注册账户或扫码。
scenarios.flow_en: Berths, directions and human help are visible on site, with no app, account or scan required.
scenarios.fail_safe_zh: 数字服务故障不阻止基本到达、问询和人工交易。
scenarios.fail_safe_en: Digital failure does not block basic arrival, inquiry or human service.

scenarios.flow_zh: 任何人可用现场人工渠道或公开网页报告误读；委员会发布修订理由、兼容期和召回范围。
scenarios.flow_en: Anyone can report misreading through an on-site human channel or public page; the panel publishes rationale, compatibility period and recall scope.
scenarios.fail_safe_zh: 高风险误读触发立即停用，不等待常规版本周期。
scenarios.fail_safe_en: A high-risk misread triggers immediate shutdown without waiting for the normal release cycle.
